members.name: inputLabel
members.doc: The accessible name of the textarea, when `inputProps` gives it neither an `aria-label` nor an `aria-labelledby`.

members.name: value
members.doc: The text, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The text at first, when the composer controls itself. A form reset restores it.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with the new text each time it changes.

members.name: inputProps
members.doc: Native textarea props. `form` associates text and Send with that external form's validation, submission and reset.

members.name: onSend
members.doc: Runs only when the composer host form receives an uncancelled submission, with the text.

members.name: onStop
members.doc: Called when Stop is pressed. Stop replaces Send while `pending`, and shows only with this callback.

members.name: pending
members.doc: Makes the text read-only and disables the auxiliary actions. Stop replaces Send when `onStop` is given.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Prevents all editing and actions.

members.name: error
members.doc: A message shown with the composer, associated with the textarea and announced; it also marks the textarea invalid.

members.name: sources
members.doc: The records a caret token beginning with @ at a word boundary suggests. Up and Down choose, Enter inserts, and Escape dismisses.

members.name: commands
members.doc: The records a caret token beginning with / at a word boundary suggests. Up and Down choose, Enter inserts, and Escape dismisses.

members.name: onSuggestionSelect
members.doc: Called with the chosen record and its kind when a suggestion is inserted. Insertion replaces only the current token, respects `maxLength`, and never sends.

members.name: attachments
members.doc: Display records for the files attached. Each shows with a remove button when `onRemoveAttachment` is given.

members.name: onRemoveAttachment
members.doc: Called with the id of an attachment whose remove button was pressed.

members.name: onFilesSelected
members.doc: Shows an attach button that opens a native file picker, and receives the chosen files. Nothing is uploaded.

members.name: accept
members.doc: The file types the attach picker accepts, as the native input's `accept`.

members.name: multiple
members.doc: Whether the attach picker admits several files.

members.name: models
members.doc: The models the picker offers. It renders only with `models` and `onModelChange`.

members.name: selectedModel
members.doc: The id of the selected model, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultSelectedModel
members.doc: The id of the model selected at first, when the composer controls itself; without one, the first model. A form reset restores it.

members.name: onModelChange
members.doc: Called with the id of the chosen model.

members.name: onDictation
members.doc: Shows a dictation button that calls this when pressed. Mux UI performs no recognition.
